product_overview: Sefay is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for POS, inventory, purchasing, HR, loyalty, billing, and subscriptions. It supports tenant-scoped operations, bilingual UI workflows, and a separate superadmin console for platform-wide management.
core_goals: Provide secure multi-tenant authentication and session management
Enable role-based access control for tenant users
Support end-to-end POS, inventory, and purchasing workflows
Manage customers, HR, expenses, coupons, and gift cards
Provide reporting, notifications, tenant settings, and subscription management
Expose superadmin tools for cross-tenant administration and platform health

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allows users to register, log in, refresh sessions, view their account, and manage active sessions.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/auth/register with valid tenant and user details -> Receive 201 with new tenant/account created -> POST /api/v1/auth/login with registered credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT access token and refresh token cookie -> GET /api/v1/auth/me with access token -> Receive 200 with current user profile
POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized error -> POST /api/v1/auth/refresh without a valid refresh-token cookie -> Receive 401 token refresh error

POST /api/v1/auth/logout with valid JWT access token -> Receive 200 and current session invalidated -> GET /api/v1/auth/sessions with the same token -> Receive 401 or updated session list without the revoked session

features.name: Access Control (RBAC)
features.description: Lets authenticated users inspect and manage permission groups, permissions, and roles within the tenant.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/access-control/permission-groups with valid JWT -> Receive 200 with permission group list -> GET /api/v1/access-control/roles -> Receive 200 with role list -> POST /api/v1/access-control/roles with a valid role payload -> Receive 201 with created role -> PATCH /api/v1/access-control/roles/:roleId/permissions/:permissionKey -> Receive 200 with updated role permission

GET /api/v1/access-control/roles/:roleId/permissions for a non-existent role -> Receive 404 role not found -> DELETE /api/v1/access-control/roles/:roleId/permissions/:permissionKey with insufficient privileges -> Receive 403 forbidden

POST /api/v1/access-control/roles/:roleId/reset with valid admin token -> Receive 200 and permissions reset to defaults -> GET /api/v1/access-control/roles/:roleId/users -> Receive 200 with users assigned to the role

features.name: Branches
features.description: Provides CRUD management for branch or location records used by tenant operations.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/branches with a valid branch payload -> Receive 201 with new branch ID -> GET /api/v1/branches -> Receive 200 with branch list -> PATCH /api/v1/branches/:id with updates -> Receive 200 with modified branch
GET /api/v1/branches/:id for an unknown branch -> Receive 404 branch not found -> DELETE /api/v1/branches/:id for a branch already removed -> Receive 404 or conflict error

features.name: Items Catalog
features.description: Manages items, variants, categories, brands, units, barcodes, and supplier catalog entries.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/items with item details -> Receive 201 with created item -> POST /api/v1/items/:itemId/variants with variant data -> Receive 201 with created variant -> GET /api/v1/item-barcodes/lookup/:barcode -> Receive 200 with matching item or variant details
GET /api/v1/items/:id for a missing item -> Receive 404 item not found -> POST /api/v1/item-barcodes/lookup/:barcode for an unknown barcode -> Receive 404 or empty lookup result

POST /api/v1/categories with a valid category name -> Receive 201 with created category -> POST /api/v1/brands and POST /api/v1/units with valid payloads -> Receive 201 for each created reference record

features.name: Inventory Management
features.description: Tracks stock levels, movements, adjustments, transfers, warehouses, locations, reorder points, counts, reservations, WMS actions, and inventory analytics.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/inventory/stock/levels with valid JWT -> Receive 200 with current stock levels -> POST /api/v1/inventory/adjustments with adjustment details -> Receive 201 with adjustment in draft or pending status -> POST /api/v1/inventory/adjustments/:id/approve -> Receive 200 approved -> POST /api/v1/inventory/adjustments/:id/post -> Receive 200 posted and stock updated

POST /api/v1/inventory/transfers with source and destination warehouses -> Receive 201 with transfer created -> POST /api/v1/inventory/transfers/:id/approve -> Receive 200 approved -> POST /api/v1/inventory/transfers/:id/dispatch -> Receive 200 dispatched -> POST /api/v1/inventory/transfers/:id/receive -> Receive 200 received and stock reconciled

POST /api/v1/inventory/counts with count metadata -> Receive 201 with count session created -> PATCH /api/v1/inventory/counts/:id/items/:itemId with counted quantity -> Receive 200 item count saved -> POST /api/v1/inventory/counts/:id/finalize -> Receive 200 finalized count report
GET /api/v1/inventory/reorder-points/below-minimum -> Receive 200 with low-stock items -> GET /api/v1/inventory/reports/expiring-batches -> Receive 200 with expiring batch list

POST /api/v1/inventory/adjustments/:id/approve for a non-existent adjustment -> Receive 404 not found -> POST /api/v1/inventory/transfers/:id/receive before dispatch -> Receive 409 invalid transfer state

features.name: Purchasing
features.description: Supports procure-to-pay workflows including purchase requests, purchase orders, agreements, RFQs, awards, goods receipts, suppliers, amendments, releases, and supplier quotes.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/purchasing/purchase-requests with request items -> Receive 201 with purchase request created -> POST /api/v1/purchasing/purchase-orders with request reference -> Receive 201 with purchase order in draft status -> POST /api/v1/purchasing/purchase-orders/:id/submit -> Receive 200 submitted -> POST /api/v1/purchasing/purchase-orders/:id/approve -> Receive 200 approved

POST /api/v1/purchasing/purchase-orders/:id/reject for an already approved order -> Receive 409 or invalid state error -> POST /api/v1/purchasing/purchase-orders/:id/cancel for a completed order -> Receive 409 cancellation not allowed

POST /api/v1/purchasing/rfqs with supplier and item details -> Receive 201 RFQ created -> POST /api/v1/purchasing/rfqs/:id/send -> Receive 200 sent to suppliers -> POST /api/v1/purchasing/awards with winning quote data -> Receive 201 award created -> POST /api/v1/purchasing/awards/:id/create-purchase-orders -> Receive 200 purchase orders generated
POST /api/v1/purchasing/goods-receipts with received goods -> Receive 201 goods receipt created -> POST /api/v1/purchasing/goods-receipts/:id/post -> Receive 200 posted and inventory updated

GET /api/v1/purchasing/suppliers/:id/profile-stats for unknown supplier -> Receive 404 supplier not found -> POST /api/v1/purchasing/amendments with invalid source document -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Invoices & Point of Sale
features.description: Enables invoice creation, held orders, invoice cancellation, shift opening and closing, and POS configuration retrieval.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/shifts/open with valid cashier context -> Receive 200 shift opened -> POST /api/v1/invoices with cart and payment details -> Receive 201 invoice created -> GET /api/v1/invoices/:id -> Receive 200 invoice details

POST /api/v1/invoices/held with order data -> Receive 201 held invoice created -> GET /api/v1/invoices/held -> Receive 200 held orders list -> PATCH /api/v1/invoices/held/:id/visibility -> Receive 200 visibility updated
PATCH /api/v1/invoices/:id/cancel with a cancellable invoice -> Receive 200 cancelled invoice -> GET /api/v1/invoices/:id -> Receive 200 invoice showing cancelled status
POST /api/v1/invoices with invalid or incomplete cart data -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /api/v1/shifts/:id/close for a closed shift -> Receive 409 shift already closed
GET /api/v1/tenant/pos-config with valid JWT -> Receive 200 POS configuration including tenant settings

features.name: Customers CRM
features.description: Provides customer directory management, purchase history access, stats, and custom customer field definitions.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/customers with customer profile data -> Receive 201 created customer -> GET /api/v1/customers/:id/history -> Receive 200 purchase history -> GET /api/v1/customers/stats -> Receive 200 customer metrics
GET /api/v1/customers/:id for an unknown customer -> Receive 404 customer not found -> POST /api/v1/customer-field-definitions with invalid field schema -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/v1/customer-field-definitions -> Receive 200 list of custom fields -> POST /api/v1/customer-field-definitions with valid field definition -> Receive 201 created definition

features.name: HR (Attendance, Leaves, Schedules, Shifts, Employees, Users)
features.description: Manages attendance check-in/out, attendance records, leave approvals, schedules, shift patterns, geofences, employees, and users.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/attendance/check-in with user credentials and valid location -> Receive 200 check-in recorded -> GET /api/v1/attendance/me -> Receive 200 current attendance summary -> POST /api/v1/attendance/check-out -> Receive 200 check-out recorded

POST /api/v1/attendance/check-in from outside the employee geofence -> Receive 403 geofence violation or attendance exception needed -> POST /api/v1/attendance/exceptions with exception details -> Receive 201 exception created

GET /api/v1/leaves -> Receive 200 leave request list -> PATCH /api/v1/leaves/:id/approve -> Receive 200 leave approved -> PATCH /api/v1/leaves/:id/reject for a rejected request -> Receive 200 or 409 based on current state

POST /api/v1/schedules with schedule payload -> Receive 201 schedule created -> POST /api/v1/shift-patterns with pattern data -> Receive 201 shift pattern created -> POST /api/v1/employees/:id/link with a matching user -> Receive 200 employee linked
PATCH /api/v1/users/:id/role with an invalid role ID -> Receive 404 or validation error -> GET /api/v1/employees/linkable-users -> Receive 200 candidate users

features.name: Expenses
features.description: Tracks expenses, categories, templates, and approval or rejection actions.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/expenses with expense details -> Receive 201 expense created -> GET /api/v1/expenses -> Receive 200 expense list -> PATCH /api/v1/expenses/:id/approve -> Receive 200 approved expense
POST /api/v1/expenses with malformed amount or category -> Receive 400 validation error -> PATCH /api/v1/expenses/:id/reject for a non-existent expense -> Receive 404 not found
GET /api/v1/expense-categories -> Receive 200 category list -> GET /api/v1/expense-templates -> Receive 200 template list

features.name: Coupons & Gift Cards
features.description: Allows validation and management of discount coupons and gift cards.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/coupons with coupon details -> Receive 201 created coupon -> POST /api/v1/coupons/validate with a valid code -> Receive 200 coupon is valid
POST /api/v1/coupons/validate with an expired or unknown code -> Receive 400 or 404 validation failure -> GET /api/v1/coupons -> Receive 200 coupon list
POST /api/v1/gift-cards with gift card details -> Receive 201 created gift card -> POST /api/v1/gift-cards/validate with active card code -> Receive 200 gift card is valid
POST /api/v1/gift-cards/validate with depleted balance or invalid code -> Receive 400 or 404 validation failure

features.name: Reports
features.description: Provides analytics reports for revenue, expenses, payroll, inventory, tax, sparklines, and recent activity.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/reports/revenue with valid JWT -> Receive 200 revenue report -> GET /api/v1/reports/tax -> Receive 200 tax summary -> GET /api/v1/reports/recent-activity -> Receive 200 activity feed
GET /api/v1/reports/payroll for an unauthorized role -> Receive 403 forbidden -> GET /api/v1/reports/inventory with a valid token -> Receive 200 inventory report
GET /api/v1/reports/sparklines -> Receive 200 compact trend data -> GET /api/v1/reports/expenses -> Receive 200 expense analytics

features.name: Table Management / Dine-in / Kitchen
features.description: Supports table setup, opening and checkout, kitchen order monitoring, waitlist, and reservations.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/tables with table data -> Receive 201 table created -> POST /api/v1/tables/:id/open -> Receive 200 table opened -> GET /api/v1/kitchen/orders -> Receive 200 kitchen queue items -> PATCH /api/v1/kitchen/items/:id -> Receive 200 kitchen item status updated

GET /api/v1/waitlist -> Receive 200 waitlist entries -> POST /api/v1/waitlist with customer details -> Receive 201 customer added to waitlist -> POST /api/v1/reservations with reservation data -> Receive 201 reservation created
POST /api/v1/tables/:id/checkout for a table with no open check -> Receive 409 invalid table state -> POST /api/v1/reservations with conflicting booking time -> Receive 409 reservation conflict

features.name: Tenant Settings & Loyalty
features.description: Manages tenant profile, subscription status, loyalty tiers, and subscription changes.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/tenant/profile -> Receive 200 tenant profile -> PATCH /api/v1/tenant/profile with updated business details -> Receive 200 updated tenant profile -> GET /api/v1/tenant/subscription -> Receive 200 subscription details
GET /api/v1/loyalty-tiers -> Receive 200 loyalty tier list -> POST /api/v1/loyalty-tiers with tier configuration -> Receive 201 new loyalty tier

GET /api/v1/subscriptions/current -> Receive 200 active subscription -> POST /api/v1/subscriptions/upgrade with plan selection -> Receive 200 upgrade initiated -> DELETE /api/v1/subscriptions/cancel -> Receive 200 cancellation scheduled
PATCH /api/v1/tenant/profile with invalid payload -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /api/v1/subscriptions/upgrade without billing eligibility -> Receive 402 or 409 billing error

features.name: Notifications & Payments
features.description: Lets authenticated users view notifications and payment reconciliation views, and mark notifications as read.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/notifications -> Receive 200 notification list -> PATCH /api/v1/notifications/:id/read -> Receive 200 notification marked as read -> PATCH /api/v1/notifications/read-all -> Receive 200 all notifications marked read
GET /api/v1/payments -> Receive 200 payment list -> GET /api/v1/payments/invoices -> Receive 200 invoice reconciliation view
PATCH /api/v1/notifications/:id/read for a missing notification -> Receive 404 not found -> GET /api/v1/payments for a user without permission -> Receive 403 forbidden

features.name: Superadmin Console
features.description: Provides cross-tenant administration tools for tenant lifecycle, analytics, audit logs, queues, health, and subscription oversight.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/superadmin/tenants with superadmin token -> Receive 200 tenant list -> GET /api/v1/superadmin/tenants/:id -> Receive 200 tenant details -> PATCH /api/v1/superadmin/tenants/:id/activate -> Receive 200 tenant activated
PATCH /api/v1/superadmin/tenants/:id/deactivate for a non-existent tenant -> Receive 404 not found -> DELETE /api/v1/superadmin/tenants/:id for a protected tenant -> Receive 409 or forbidden error

GET /api/v1/superadmin/analytics/summary -> Receive 200 platform summary metrics -> GET /api/v1/superadmin/analytics/mrr -> Receive 200 MRR report -> GET /api/v1/superadmin/audit-logs -> Receive 200 audit log list
GET /api/v1/superadmin/queues -> Receive 200 queue status -> GET /api/v1/superadmin/health -> Receive 200 health status -> GET /api/v1/superadmin/subscriptions -> Receive 200 subscription list

features.name: Health & Webhooks
features.description: Exposes public health and metrics endpoints and a signature-verified Stripe webhook receiver.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/health -> Receive 200 public health status -> GET /api/v1/health/db -> Receive 200 database health status -> GET /api/v1/metrics -> Receive 200 Prometheus metrics

POST /api/v1/webhooks/stripe with a valid Stripe signature -> Receive 200 webhook accepted and processed -> POST /api/v1/webhooks/stripe with invalid signature -> Receive 400 signature verification failed
GET /api/v1/health/db when the database is unavailable -> Receive 503 service unavailable

tech_stack: PostgreSQL (via Supabase PostgREST/RPC + raw pg driver)
Multi-tenant architecture with tenant-scoped JWT and per-tenant rate limiting

known_limitations.issue: Tenant isolation and permission-key enforcement not verifiable from static analysis alone
known_limitations.impact: Must be verified at test-execution time - cross-tenant data leakage and privilege escalation are high-value backend test targets per project's own testsprite_instructions.md

known_limitations.issue: Rate limiting on auth endpoints (10 req/60s) may cause 429s during automated test runs that retry logins frequently
known_limitations.impact: Backend test suite should pace login attempts to avoid false-positive failures from throttling
